text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered -> high error-rate alert: HTTP 5xx spike on inference-gateway-usw2 (threshold breach: 12m avg 7.8% -> 18.9%). Link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/8309991234 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: INC-8309991 routed to primary oncall @oncall-alex (level 1). escalation in 6m if unacked.
oncall-alex: Acked. I'm on it. Starting triage.
sre-lee: I see the spike correlated with increased upstream 502s from kv-proxy pool-12. Error mix: 502/504 spike, some 503s. Request rate steady.
eng-runtime-maya: Noted. Any recent rollouts? Canary for kv-proxy was promoted ~30m ago to us-west-2-blue.
sre-lee: Checking deploy history... confirmed canary->promote at 8309989000. Rolling back in 5 if impact persists.
support-jordan: Support queue: 8 customer reports, mostly chat features failing with "upstream error". No major billing impact yet, but UX broken for some sessions.
oncall-alex: Good context. @sre-lee please collect a short impact blurb for PD and update status page. I'll coordinate rollback if needed.
sre-lee: Quick check logs:
```
[2026-03-17T19:07:02Z] proxy/kv-proxy pool-12 error=upstream-502 host=10.120.5.12 latency=6ms
[2026-03-17T19:07:03Z] proxy/kv-proxy pool-12 error=upstream-502 host=10.120.5.14 latency=8ms
```
Patterns show sudden per-peer 502 bursts, not timeouts.
eng-runtime-maya: I can patch a defensive fallback in the router to skip the kv-proxy for read-only prefix cache for 10m while we remediate. Patch ready, can deploy to canary in 2m.
oncall-alex: Do it. Prioritize quick mitigation over full rollback.
sre-lee: Starting traffic slice reroute away from pool-12 now (manual reroute + warmup). Watching error rate.
sre-lee: Error-rate dropping -> 18.9% -> 9.2% in 60s after reroute. Keep monitoring.
support-jordan: Informing affected customers with ETA ~10m for full recovery.
oncall-alex: Update PD note: root cause suspected kv-proxy peer degradation after canary promotion. Mitigation: traffic reroute + router fallback patch. Monitoring. Will escalate to ENG if sustained.
incident-bot: Alert suppressed (auto-silenced) following ack and active mitigation. Will reopen if error-rate >10% for 3m.
oncall-alex: Handing off to @sre-lee for follow-up post-mitigation. I'll remain reachable for escalation. :thumbsup:
